slides.title: Ask your questions, any time
slides.body: A tutor that explains step by step, adapted to your class and level. If you don't understand, it explains differently.

slides.title: Get your homework corrected
slides.body: Take a photo of your exercise: SAVI reads it, spots the mistakes and explains the correction.

slides.title: Revise with your own courses
slides.body: Import your PDFs and course photos. Summaries, quizzes, exercises and answers based only on your documents.

slides.title: Prepare your exams
slides.body: Timed mock exams, detailed corrections and subject-by-subject progress tracking.
